title: Finite extension with depth two at every point above the boundary
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme, meaning it has an affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $U$ be an open of $L$. Assume $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{L,y}\geq2$ for every $y\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. For every finite etale morphism $f:X\to U$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism], there exist a finite $p:E\to L$ and an isomorphism $e:E|_U\cong X$ over $U$, such that $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{E,z}\geq2$ whenever $p(z)\notin U$. No etaleness of $p$, smooth base, or fibre-density assumption is asserted or required.

source.place: Tag 0EY6(1),(2); coherence step expanded using coherent extension and double duals, Tag 0E9I, and Tag 0AUK

proof.text: Form g = f followed by U inclusion and its actual direct image algebra B, using g sharp. Apply depth_two_pushforward_coherence to obtain quasi-coherence, finite structure maps on affine opens, and finite boundary stalk modules of depth at least two.

Apply exists_affine_structure_algebra to B. This supplies a scheme E, an affine p:E -> L and an algebra isomorphism alpha:B -> p_* O_E. On each affine open, the structure map p sharp is B structure map followed by the corresponding isomorphism component. A ring isomorphism is finite by surjectivity, and finite ring maps compose, so p is finite.

Restrict alpha to U using sheaf pullback. The canonical restriction algebra identification rho from affine_morphism_relative_spec identifies (p_* O_E)|U with (p restricted to U)_* O. The explicit presheaf restriction isomorphism identifies B|U with f_* O_X: inverse image under f followed by U inclusion of the image of an open W of U equals f inverse image of W, and naturality of f sharp gives the algebra equation. Full faithfulness of the affine structure-algebra equivalence lifts this algebra isomorphism to an isomorphism e:(p inverse image U) -> X over U. Its Over equation is exactly e.hom followed by f = p restricted to U.

Apply depth_two_of_finite_structure_algebra to B, its boundary depth estimates, p and alpha. It yields the required depth of every E stalk above the boundary. Assemble E, p, finiteness, this depth estimate and the over-U isomorphism, preserving the original statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_extension_of_depth_two
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y) (L.presheaf.stalk y))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite f] [Etale f] :
    ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (p : E ⟶ L), IsFinite p ∧
      (∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)) ∧
      ∃ e : (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ≅ X, e.hom ≫ f = p ∣_ U
